card.provider: OpenAI Files API — per-project file storage
card.summary: 2.5 TB per project; 512 MB per file; no organization-wide storage cap; orgs may create up to 2,000 projects by default

record.provider: OpenAI Files API — per-project file storage

free_tier.stated: 2.5 TB per project; 512 MB per file; no organization-wide storage cap; orgs may create up to 2,000 projects by default

egress.terms: Not metered separately for upload/download of files; retrieval is a plain authenticated GET. No published per-GB transfer fee on the Files API surface.

record.interface_detail: REST `POST/GET/DELETE /v1/files`, `GET /v1/files/{file_id}/content`; OpenAI SDKs; works through OpenAI-compatible gateways
record.tooling: openai-python, openai-node, curl; `purpose` field selects the lifecycle class
record.chaining: 2,000 projects/org x 2.5 TB = nominally 5 PB per org. Files are project-scoped and cannot be moved between projects, so a pooler must track (project -> file_id). Because `purpose=batch` and `purpose=vision` are both uploadable AND downloadable, they are the only two classes usable as actual storage.
record.limits_note: Per-object-cap 512 MB. Upload rate 1,000 requests/min/authenticated user. Vector-store attachment has its own 2,000 files/min/org limit. `purpose` is the real gate. See reliability_note.
record.reliability_note: READ GATE IS PER-PURPOSE, NOT PER-ACCOUNT. An OpenAI staff-adjacent answer on the developer forum gives the directionality table: assistants up/NO down; user_data up/NO down; fine-tune up/NO down; evals up/NO down; batch up/YES down; vision up/YES down; *_output down only. So `purpose=user_data` and `purpose=assistants` are write-only. Uploading there is data loss. Storage is genuinely free (no per-GB-day charge for raw files; the $0.10/GB-day on the pricing page is vector store storage, not Files API storage). Identity: ChatGPT signup is email-only, but generating the FIRST API key now mandates phone verification (SMS or WhatsApp, one number reusable 3x, rolled out to a listed set of countries). That is the binding constraint here.

evidence.proved: 'Individual files can be up to 512 MB, and each project can store up to 2.5 TB of files in total. There is no organization-wide storage limit. Uploads ... rate-limited to 1,000 requests per minute'
'OpenAI currently supports a file storage quota of 2.5 TB of files per project', updated 2 days ago
'Organizations can create up to 2,000 projects by default'; 'Project resources (such as files, assistants, storage, or threads) are scoped to the project'
'Retrieve file content: get /files/{file_id}/content'
directionality table; 'Not allowed to download files of purpose: user_data'
'You can't download files that you've uploaded to the assistants yourself'
'File search | Storage | $0.10 / GB per day (1 GB free)' — this is vector-store storage, NOT raw file storage
'Phone verification is now mandated on platform.openai.com for generating your initial API key'
PROBE: curl -D - -> HTTP/1.1 401, Content-Length 616, real JSON error, x-openai-proxy-wasm; /v1/files/{id}/content also 401/616 — endpoint live, not a 0-byte 200
